text.A: **Sera hii inatumika popote ulipo.** Tunafuata sheria ya Uingereza ya ulinzi wa data, na pale sheria ya ulinzi wa data ya nchi unayoishi inapotumika pia, tunaifuata hiyo pia.
text.B: **Maelezo ya mzio na ya lishe.** Tunayapitisha kwa food truck pamoja na oda yako na hatuyatumii kwa jambo lingine lolote. Tunayaondoa, pamoja na jina lako na taarifa zako za mawasiliano, miezi 12 baada ya oda (tazama sehemu ya 7).
text.C: **Uhamishaji wa data kimataifa.** Data za akaunti yako na data za oda zinahifadhiwa na kuchakatwa nchini Uingereza. Baadhi ya mambo yanashughulikiwa nje yake: kutoa yaliyomo kwenye menyu na majibu ya kiotomatiki ya WhatsApp, ambayo yanatumia huduma ya Google nchini Marekani; kufikisha ujumbe wa WhatsApp, kunakoshughulikiwa na Meta nchini Marekani; malipo, yanayoshughulikiwa na Stripe nchini Marekani; na arifa (push notifications), zinazofikishwa na Apple na Google nchini Marekani. Pale data zinapotoka nje ya Uingereza, uhamishaji unalindwa na kanuni za utoshelevu za Uingereza (UK adequacy regulations) au na Mkataba wa Kimataifa wa Uhamishaji wa Data (International Data Transfer Agreement) au Nyongeza yake (Addendum), na, pale sheria ya nchi yako inapotaka hivyo, na kinga inayotambuliwa na sheria hiyo. Unaweza kutuomba maelezo ya kinga zinazohusika.
text.G:
[Masharti yetu ya Huduma](/terms) yanatumika katika kila nchi ambako HatchGrab inatumika. Baadhi ya nchi zina kanuni za ziada. Ukurasa huu unazieleza, nchi moja baada ya nyingine.

Pale sehemu iliyo hapa chini inapokuhusu, ni sehemu ya Masharti yetu ya Huduma. Ikisema jambo tofauti na yale, ukurasa huu ndio unaotumika kwa nchi hiyo.

Ikiwa nchi yako haijaorodheshwa, hakuna kanuni za ziada: Masharti ya Huduma yanatumika kama yalivyoandikwa. [Sera yetu ya Faragha](/privacy) ni ileile katika kila nchi.

back.A: **This policy applies wherever you are.** We follow the UK law on data protection, and where the data protection law of the country you live in also applies, we follow that as well.
back.B: **Allergy and dietary notes.** We pass them to the food truck together with your order and do not use them for any other matter. We remove them, together with your name and your contact details, 12 months after the order (see section 7).
back.C: Where data goes outside the UK, the transfer is protected by the UK adequacy regulations or by the International Data Transfer Agreement or its Addendum, and, where the law of your country requires it, by a safeguard recognised by that law.
back.D: ## 8. Your rights / Under the UK law on data protection, and the law of the country you live in where it applies, you have the right to: [7 bullets unchanged] / The law of the place where you live may give you these rights under other names, or extra rights. You have those rights too. / **Making a request.** Send an email to privacy@hatchgrab.com. We will verify that the request is genuine before handling it. You can ask another person to make the request on your behalf, and we will not treat you differently because of making a request. We will reply within one month, or sooner if the law of your country requires it. If you ordered from a food truck, we may pass your request to that food truck, because it is the one that decides how your order details are used. If we refuse a request, you can ask us to look at it again by replying to our answer. / **Deleting your account.** [old text unchanged] When an operator's account is deleted, we also remove the names, contact details and notes of its customers from the orders we keep. / **Marketing emails.** We send marketing emails only where the law of the place you live allows it, which in some countries means only with your consent. Each one says who it is from, contains our postal address and tells you how to stop receiving them. If you ask us to stop, we will stop, without charge and within 10 working days. Emails about an order or your account are not marketing. If we or a food truck offer order updates by short message, you will get them only if you agree, and you can stop them at any time. / **If something goes wrong.** If a breach involving your personal data is likely to cause you serious harm, we will inform you and the supervisory authority as early as possible where the law requires it, or we will help the food truck you ordered from to do so. / **Complaints.** Tell us first via privacy@hatchgrab.com; we would like to have the chance to put things right. You can also complain to the data protection supervisory authority of the place where you live. In the UK, that is the Office of the Information Commissioner (Information Commissioner's Office), via ico.org.uk or by phone 0303 123 1113.
back.G: Our [Terms of Service] apply in every country where HatchGrab is used. Some countries have extra rules. This page explains them, one country after another. / Where a section below concerns you, it is part of our Terms of Service. If it says something different from those, this page is the one that applies for that country. / If your country is not listed, there are no extra rules: the Terms of Service apply as they are written. Our [Privacy Policy] is the same in every country.

notes: 'Regulator' rendered as 'mamlaka ya usimamizi' (supervisory authority); the removed EEA part used 'mamlaka ya ulinzi wa data'. Text messages kept as 'ujumbe mfupi', as in the removed US part.
